mcq.question: Assertion: The common difference of 5, −1, 3, 7, … is 4. Reason: The common difference of an AP is a2 − a1.

mcq.question: Assertion: If the nth term of an AP is 7 − 4n, then the common difference is −4. Reason: The common difference is a(n+1) − a(n).

Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason does not explain Assertion.
Assertion is true and Reason is false.
Assertion is false and Reason is true.

mcq.question: Assertion: If the sum of the first n terms of an AP is 3n^2 − 4n, then the nth term is 6n − 7. Reason: The nth term is S(n) − S(n − 1).

Both Assertion and Reason are true, and Reason does not explain Assertion.
Assertion is true and Reason is false.
Assertion is false and Reason is true.

Rose saplings are planted in a spiral of successive semicircles, with centres alternating at A and B, starting at A. The radii are 50 cm, 100 cm, 150 cm, and so on. Spiral 1 has 10 saplings, spiral 2 has 20, spiral 3 has 30, and so on. (i) Find the radius of the 13th spiral. (ii) If the radius of the nth spiral is 500 cm, find n. (iii) Find the total number of saplings up to the 11th spiral. (iv) Find n if the total number of saplings is 450.
la.model_answer: The radii form an AP with first term 50 and common difference 50. The 13th radius is 650 cm. The radius 500 cm is the 10th term, so n is 10. The sapling counts form an AP with first term 10 and common difference 10. The total up to the 11th spiral is 660. The total is 450 when n is 9.
la.explanation: The radii form an AP with first term 50 and common difference 50. The 13th radius is 650 cm. The radius 500 cm is the 10th term, so n is 10. The sapling counts form an AP with first term 10 and common difference 10. The total up to the 11th spiral is 660. The total is 450 when n is 9.

la.question: A charity run has 10 rounds. The first round is 300 m, and each later round is 50 m longer than the one before it. (i) Write the fourth, fifth and sixth rounds. (ii) Find the distance of the 8th round. (iii) Find the total distance of all 10 rounds. (iv) Find the total distance of the first 6 rounds.
la.model_answer: The rounds form an AP with first term 300 and common difference 50. The fourth, fifth and sixth rounds are 450 m, 500 m and 550 m. The eighth round is 650 m. The total of 10 rounds is 5250 m. The total of the first 6 rounds is 2550 m.
la.explanation: The rounds form an AP with first term 300 and common difference 50. The fourth, fifth and sixth rounds are 450 m, 500 m and 550 m. The eighth round is 650 m. The total of 10 rounds is 5250 m. The total of the first 6 rounds is 2550 m.
